Create a clean, centered, front-facing rounded-square mobile app icon in glossy glassmorphism style for a dark modern supernatural RPG aesthetic. Important composition: the icon itself is a rounded-square glassy app tile with subtle depth and shine, isolated and centered. Surround the icon with a transparent cutout edge so it can be composited cleanly after chroma key removal.

Absolutely no gradient, no shadow, no texture, no scenery, no ground, no decoration, and no environmental elements outside the icon. Pure flat green screen background only.
